_about: Z24: packets sent by the item-side loaders' run-time helpers (useditemeffect broadcast, charged-buff expiry, production request). Offsets are payload offsets (after the opcode). Pseudocode: docs/pseudocode/zone/Z24-item-data.md.

0x3029.name: NC_ITEM_SOMEONEUSE_CMD
fields: player position (the client does not read it)
0x3029.notes: 12 bytes; sent to the surroundings when the item's useditemeffect entry has broadcast set (Z24 §1.4)

0x9002.name: NC_CHARGED_RESETBUFF_CMD
0x9002.basis: zone ChargedItemEffectElement::ciee_Free FUN_00450a50 (Z24 §6.7); the same packet goes to the WM (W04 annotation)

0x3457.name: NC_ITEMDB_PRODUCE_REQ
0x3457.basis: zone smo_ply_ItemProduce FUN_0046c2d0 + ItemProducer::ip_ProductExecute FUN_0046bf80 (Z24 §7.8); struct pdb2016
fields: 0x26: PROTO_ITEM_CREATE {u32 owner, MAPPOS map, ITEM_INVEN location, regnum, u16 createitemid, u16 attr} or PROTO_ITEM_ATTRCHANGE {regnum, u16 attr, ITEM_INVEN location}
0x11 each: u8 vanish, u16 rawid, u16 rawuselot_log, union {PROTO_ITEM_VANISH {regnum, location}, PROTO_ITEM_ATTRCHANGE}
0x3457.notes: variable length = 0x32 + 0x11·n + blobs: the iac_fill2buffer attribute blobs follow raw[n]; each attr field = payload offset of its blob; ITEM_INVEN = 0x2400 | slot (inventory type 9)
